subject: Re: Subprocessor & Supply Chain Evidence — Valence Health SIG pack

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@valencehealth.com>

Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@valencehealth.com>, procurement@valencehealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Subprocessor & supply-chain evidence request

Hi Vanessa,

We're kicking off the vendor review for our new inference platform evaluation and I need a compact evidence bundle to feed into our SIG-lite/CAIQ intake. Can you provide the following by EOD Thu, Feb 18 (PST)?

- A CSV of current subprocessors (name, country of operation, hosting region/residency, SOC 2 status or date, whether they hold crypto keys/KMS custody, and brief note on purpose).
- A one-page "SIG-lite" summary mapping: which SIG/CAIQ questions we can answer from existing artifacts and where we have gaps.
- Any SOC 2 or CAIQ artifacts you can share, or links to the Drive location where they're hosted.

If there are known residency exceptions (e.g., onshore-only requirement issues) call them out in the CSV. If you cannot meet the Feb 18 date, tell me the quickest alternate delivery.

Also helpful: an overview of your fallback strategy if a subprocessor is out of residency scope (short bullet list).

Appreciate it — this will plug into our procurement checklist.

Tom Reynolds
Head of Vendor Risk
Valence Health
